review.use_summary: Phased 23andMe genotypes using Finch or Eagle2 before Minimac3 imputation with combined 1000 Genomes Phase III and UK10K reference data.
review.implementation_scope_note: The paper allows either Finch or Eagle2 and does not assign an engine to each sample or platform. The phasing edition and complete options are unstated; genotype QC, ancestry classification, imputation and association are separate operations.

review.use_summary: Used Eagle2 with Minimac4 in a local Michigan Imputation Server 1.5.7 pipeline with the 1000G Phase3 v5 reference panel.
review.implementation_scope_note: The server edition is not an Eagle edition. Earlier QC and later MAF, PCA and relatedness filters belong to the surrounding pipeline; a complete Eagle command and the phasing reference mode are not reported.

review.use_summary: Combined GLIMPSE2 and Eagle to infer individual genotypes from single-cell ATAC-seq reads.
review.implementation_scope_note: The paragraph delegates the complete workflow and QC to a supplementary note. It does not establish the Eagle edition, input conversion, phasing mode or exact order of all steps; GLIMPSE2 and read processing remain separate.

review.use_summary: Pre-phased with Eagle2 2.4.1 before Minimac4 1.0.2 imputation; chromosome-X haplotypes and sex-specific imputation are described separately.
review.implementation_scope_note: The imputation panels include 1000 Genomes Phase3 v5 and selected high-coverage GRCh38 data. Do not assume these specify an Eagle reference-panel command. Sex/ploidy, build, genetic map and unreported phasing options require explicit declarations.

review.use_summary: Phased array batches with Eagle 2.4 through TOPMed Imputation Server before Minimac4 imputation using the TOPMed reference panel.
review.implementation_scope_note: Post-imputation filtering, merging, duplicate-sample selection and HapMap3 restriction are separate stages. The TOPMed imputation panel does not by itself specify all Eagle inputs or options.

review.use_summary: Phased Danish array genotypes with Eagle 2.4.1 before a distinct haplotype-sharing HMM imputed high-quality variants into the larger genotyped cohort.
review.implementation_scope_note: Graphtyper calling and the subsequent Li-Stephens-style imputation are separate operations. Do not label the imputation algorithm as Eagle or IMPUTE2 execution solely from the model comparison.

review.use_summary: Pre-phased array genotypes and phased the SISu reference-panel whole-genome callset with Eagle 2.3.5, using 20,000 conditioning haplotypes and otherwise reported defaults.
review.implementation_scope_note: Subsequent population-specific imputation uses Beagle 4.1; GATK calling and Hail QC are separate. A current 2.4.1 fixture cannot establish 2.3.5 or historical SISu cohort parity.

review.use_summary: Used Eagle 2.4 for haplotype phasing in the Michigan Imputation Server workflow, followed by minimac4 imputation with HRC r1.1 2016.
review.implementation_scope_note: Allele matching, strand flips, QC and downstream single-nucleus demultiplexing are separate steps. The paper does not provide a complete phasing command or identify all phasing-mode inputs.

review.use_summary: Used Eagle 2.3 phased genotypes within Michigan Imputation Server imputation with HRC r1.1 2016 and the European population setting.
review.implementation_scope_note: Array genotype calling and HRC/1KG input checking are separate operations. The complete Eagle build, phasing command and panel mode are not identified.

review.use_summary: Phased Omani genotypes with Eagle 2.4.1 and a GRCh38 genetic map before RFMix2 local-ancestry inference.
review.implementation_scope_note: The high-coverage phased 1000 Genomes callset is described as reference genotypes in the RFMix section; its assignment to an Eagle reference-mode command is not explicit. RFMix EM/window/generation settings do not describe Eagle.

review.use_summary: Phased each of three separately imputed cohorts with Eagle 2.4 through Michigan Imputation Server, alongside Minimac4/HRC GRCh37 imputation.
review.implementation_scope_note: The hg18-to-hg19 lift, imputation quality threshold, population selection and post-imputation variant removal are separate stages. A full Eagle command and its phasing-reference mode are unstated.
